items.title: a) Increase in pressure or decrease in volume:

source_refs.note: a) Increase in pressure or decrease in volume:: a main subheading of 8.13 The effect of a change in pressure or volume, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 181-181.

blocks.text: For the forward reaction, the number of moles and hence volume decreases. At equilibrium stage the volume occupied by the mixture is less than the volume at the initial stage under the given conditions. So, if pressure is increased at equilibrium, more ammonia is produced. It means, that reaction is shifted to the forward direction.
